findings.summary: test 6 'fails open on an unreadable registry' was vacuous: it used an UNDECLARED project, so the guard exited at the declared-check (.claude/vfkb-guard.mjs:72) and never reached the registry read at :79 that the test was named for — a behavioural duplicate of test 5. It also asserted the wrong behaviour: a declared project with an unreadable registry BANNERS (correct — an unreadable registry cannot show the plugin as fulfilled), it does not stay silent. Proof of zero coverage: mutation M5 (:90 registry catch -> rethrow) left all 6 tests green. Replaced with three discriminating tests (missing registry, malformed registry, unreadable project settings.json); M5 now turns two of them red.

The identical $HOME-hardcoding defect this PR fixes was live in .claude/commands/vfkb-new-project.md:105 — the skill's 'Install record exists (observed, not asserted)' verification step — and restated as prose at :86. Run verbatim under a wrapper launcher it raises FileNotFoundError; on a machine where ~/.claude happens to exist it prints False and reports a successful install as failed: the same cry-wolf failure mode, in a surface scripts/review-gate.mjs DOES classify as implementation. Fixed at both sites to honour $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; A/B verified live under cldp (old raises FileNotFoundError, new prints True).

PR body carried two false claims: 'new, 6 tests' (there are 8) and 'unreadable registry -> fails open, silent, exit 0' (it banners — the exact assertion F1 disproved). Not in git history (repo squash_merge_commit_message=COMMIT_MESSAGES, verified via gh api), but wrong on the page an operator reads to decide the merge. PR body rewritten; the commit message on 1932288 was accurate throughout.

docs/CONSUMER-ONBOARDING.md:50 — the canonical consumer doc, and the file that nominates .claude/vfkb-guard.mjs as the artefact consumers fetch — still described the guard as comparing against '~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json'. Updated to <config-dir>/plugins/… with the $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-else-~/.claude rule and the reason.

A behavioural change to an ADR-decided mechanism was landing with only a gotcha (cedbbfe22325) and a handoff fact (bed378c35c89) in the brain and no decision entry, against CLAUDE.md's standing capture rule. ADR-0059's decided body (lines 4, 33, 42) specifies the literal ~/.claude path and ADR-0001 makes it immutable, so the ADR was deliberately NOT edited; the deviation is recorded as decision 0305224042fe instead.

Pre-existing, not introduced by this diff: isImplementation('.claude/vfkb-guard.mjs') returns false (scripts/review-gate.mjs:35 covers .claude/commands/ only, confirmed by executing the exported function), so a guard-only change to this shipped consumer artefact merges with no review record — this PR was caught only because it also touches test/. Deliberately not fixed here: scripts/review-gate.selftest.mjs:295-305 asserts isImplementation directly, which would drag the gate's own selftest into the PR that gate is judging. Filed as issue #280 so the deferral is tracked rather than dropped.

mutationsNote: Two mutations deliberately recorded as green-by-construction rather than omitted. M7 (:71 declared-check catch -> rethrow alone) and M8 (:105 outer catch -> rethrow alone) leave all 8 tests green. M7: everything inside that try can only throw from readFileSync or JSON.parse, after which `declared` keeps its initialised false and :72 exits 0 silently — identical to the outer catch's exit-0-silent, so no reachable input distinguishes them; M10 (both gutted together) DOES go red, so the contract is guarded and the branch is redundant, not untested. M8: the outer catch is unreachable from any test-suppliable input — enumerated and probed (NUL-in-env rejected at spawn by libuv before the guard runs; closed fd 1 and EPIPE stdout both non-throwing; the imports at :29-31 sit outside the try entirely). It is unconditional structural defence against a future edit moving code out of an inner block. M11 (:104 exit(0) -> exit(3)) turns 6 of 8 red, so the 'exits 0' half of the fail-open contract is asserted rather than merely narrated in a comment. | Record sha note: the adversarial review read tree 1932288f99d8cfc9ad9e1e9ae2d37b21ca41c65c; this record is filed against 1ff2f499b2007759068b6dae095b10204fb06917, whose tree differs from it ONLY by one appended line in .vfkb/entries.jsonl (brain fact b382745857e8, the review outcome) — an EXEMPT_PATHS file, no implementation delta.
